svg.title: R for Resume and CV Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold R reveals a resume page with a profile, experience and skills, then introduces resume and CV design through illustrative resume, CV and layout examples.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop; bold R and blue, charcoal, cream and red palette adapted from 18_R_rebranding.png; no external assets. Resume and CV examples are generic visual concepts.
